description: Figure 8 is a line plot with the x-axis representing the sample size and the y-axis showing the shared Top-6 routed experts averaged by model layers. The x-axis ranges from 0 to 2, and the y-axis ranges from 0 to 6. There are six lines in the plot, each representing a different task: Intent, Summary, Law, Code, Math, and Legal. The Intent line starts at 0 and increases steadily to 6, the Summary line starts at 0 and increases steadily to 6, the Law line starts at 0 and increases steadily to 6, the Code line starts at 0 and increases steadily to 6, the Math line starts at 0 and increases steadily to 6, and the Legal line starts at 0 and increases steadily to 6. The lines are all solid and have a different color for each task.
